base: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE premium painterly-realistic 2D tree crown sprite for Fragdachse, strictly orthographic 90-degree vertical overhead, no oblique perspective. This is a DIFFUSE BASE COLOR / NEUTRAL ALBEDO under a completely UNIFORM OVERCAST WHITE SKY: NO DIRECTIONAL LIGHT, NO SUNLIGHT, NO RIMLIGHT. Ambient occlusion only in the gaps. The mean brightness and hue of north, south, east, west AND all opposite diagonals must be equal: no left-right or top-bottom illumination gradient at all. Strong saturated slightly warm forest-green leaf color, deeper blue-green opaque cavities; not mint, gray, pale, neon, yellow-dominated, or glossy. About 10-16 LARGE uneven interlocking branch volumes containing 25-35 irregular MEDIUM leafy clusters. Realistic irregular leaf sprays, tiny leaf texture; avoid repeated beads, equally-sized spherical broccoli blobs, repeated rosettes or plastic. Clump tops are naturally leaf-green, never sparkling white/yellow points. Local cavities distributed naturally across the WHOLE crown, not biased toward one side. A complete opaque closed central leaf roof, no transparent holes or exposed skeleton in inner 80%; overlap branches continuously. Small gaps only at extreme edge. Roughly round broad filled silhouette, centered and entirely uncut, filling 84% of square canvas with at least 7% fully TRANSPARENT border on ALL sides. Source >=1024 square. Genuine alpha, no background color, ground, exterior cast shadow, trunk side, text or watermark.
forms: Form 1: nearly round, upper-right and lower-left shoulders of different sizes; broad varied foliage groups, no radial regularity.
Form 2: gently horizontal oval (1.10:1), shallow top-edge indentation and full bottom shoulders; central opaque mass.
Form 3: broad asymmetric shallow lobes, small outer right notch, uneven edge tufts, closed rounded central core.
